description: New Priority-specific synthetic case (large impact + large gap) — 'Dominant Bad Channel', 70% traffic share: Social 70,000 clicks at CVR 2.0%, peers (leave-one-out control) 30,000 clicks at CVR 6.0% combined, total 100,000 clicks. test_baseline_value = 1800/30000 = 0.06 exactly (peers only — this is the self-dilution regression fixture: under the old display-baseline formula this scenario's gap was diluted down to ~1.2pp by Social's own 70% share; against the leave-one-out control the true peer gap is the full 4.0pp). Independently computed via TwoProportionZTestAction's own formula: pooled p = 0.032, z ~= -32.9 -> evaluation_level = high, direction = below.
